comparisons.peer_topic: Diversity, Belonging and Inclusion (DB&I) Philosophy and Strategy
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD believes that building a diverse talent pipeline, encouraging a culture of respect and belonging, and increasing inclusion of unique voices strengthens the company. This approach includes fostering an environment where employees share diverse opinions and perspectives.
comparisons.comparison: Both MU and AMD articulate a foundational belief that a diverse and inclusive workforce is a strategic strength for the company. MU explicitly links its DEI commitments to serving as a roadmap for its work, while AMD states that its diverse and inclusive workforce encourages employees to share different perspectives, making the company stronger.

sentences.text: We have five diversity, equality, and inclusion ("DEI") commitments that serve as the roadmap of our DEI work internally, within our industry, and in the community at large.
To hold ourselves accountable, each commitment is assigned an executive sponsor who is responsible for its strategy and execution.
Our diverse and inclusive workforce encourages employees to share their opinions and different perspectives.
We believe that building a diverse talent pipeline, encouraging a culture of respect and belonging, and increasing inclusion of unique and underrepresented voices makes our company stronger.

comparisons.peer_topic: Integration of diversity and inclusion into corporate governance and compensation
comparisons.peer_summary: Intel integrates diversity and inclusion into its culture, performance, and management systems, linking a portion of executive and employee compensation to D&I metrics in 2024 to drive accountability.
comparisons.comparison: Both MU and INTC emphasize the governance and accountability structures surrounding their DEI commitments. MU assigns an executive sponsor to each of its five DEI commitments to drive strategy and execution. Similarly, INTC has integrated D&I into its performance and management systems, specifically linking executive and employee compensation to D&I metrics to drive accountability.

comparisons.peer_topic: Diversity and Inclusion Strategy and Initiatives
comparisons.peer_summary: NVIDIA is committed to creating an inclusive culture and building a diverse talent pipeline, particularly for women and underrepresented minorities in technology. To achieve this, the company partners with diverse institutions, embeds recruiting teams, supports women's leadership development, provides executive sponsors, trains managers on diversity, and tracks metrics on retention, pay, and engagement.
comparisons.comparison: MU and NVDA both describe structured approaches to DEI that include governance mechanisms. MU assigns executive sponsors to its DEI commitments. NVDA also utilizes executive sponsors for its internal community resource groups as part of its broader strategy to create an inclusive culture and build a diverse talent pipeline.
